major_cooldowns.name: Immolation Aura
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it about a second before the pull, then keep leaning on it as a Fury generator and AoE tool, dumping charges before Metamorphosis so Demonic Intensity can refund them.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Base cooldown per table is 30s; A Fire Inside grants a second charge and cuts the cooldown by 6s.

major_cooldowns.name: The Hunt
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it to engage on pull and again on its cycle to empower your next Eye Beam through Eternal Hunt; when playing Fel-Scarred, hold it until right after Metamorphosis instead of using it just before.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Table base cooldown is 90s; the Eternal Hunt apex talent reduces it to a 60s effective cooldown, per the guide.

major_cooldowns.name: Eye Beam
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it as close to on cooldown as possible to trigger Demonic and ramp Cycle of Hatred, holding only in single target when adds are about to spawn before it comes back up.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Table base cooldown is 30s; Cycle of Hatred stacking reduces the effective cycle to 20s once fully stacked, per the guide.

major_cooldowns.name: Essence Break
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it for its burst debuff, ideally landing it inside Metamorphosis or right after Eye Beam so you can pack in as many Death Sweep and Annihilation casts as possible, without forcing an unnatural delay against Eye Beam.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Table base cooldown is 40s; the guide states it reaches an effective 30s cooldown at 4 stacks of Cycle of Hatred synergy.

major_cooldowns.name: Metamorphosis
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Enter Demon Form once Eye Beam and Blade Dance are both on cooldown so Chaotic Transformation resets them, aiming to enter with high Fury and to spend it down during the window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 200166 is the confirmed cast id in the sampled parses; the guide's own text cites 191427, which the table lists as sharing this name.

defensives.name: Blur
defensives.usage_rule: Press Blur when you need a burst of survivability against incoming damage, since it reduces damage taken for its duration.

defensives.name: Darkness
defensives.usage_rule: Use Darkness before a heavy raid-damage window, since it reduces damage taken for you and nearby allies while it is active.

rules.description: Open with The Hunt into Eye Beam then Essence Break
rules.action: Engage with The Hunt, then get Eye Beam and Essence Break on cooldown before you press Metamorphosis.

rules.description: Metamorphosis after Eye Beam is on cooldown
rules.action: Cast Eye Beam before you press Metamorphosis so Chaotic Transformation gets a fresh reset.

rules.description: Metamorphosis after Blade Dance is on cooldown
rules.action: Cast Blade Dance before you press Metamorphosis so Chaotic Transformation resets it for a double window.

rules.description: Consume Demonsurge with Death Sweep or Annihilation
rules.action: Spend Demonsurge procs right away with Death Sweep or Annihilation before the buff falls off.

rules.description: Keep Exergy active by retreating on cooldown
rules.action: Cast Vengeful Retreat on cooldown to refresh Exergy and keep its damage buff at full uptime.

rules.description: Immolation Aura ramps up in AoE
rules.action: Lean on Immolation Aura more as more targets are in range, since its Ragefire and cleave scale with target count.
